baseline: Frozen selected campaign09 continued-mixture FP32 model/head/correctness mapping; no new gradient training or label/threshold changes.
hypothesis: Dynamic integer quantization targets the native dense kernels that dominate local runtime, reducing CPU time and memory while preserving independently measured semantic quality.

variants.name: int8-dense
variants.change: ONNX Runtime1.32 dynamic U8U8, per_channel=false, reduce_range=false, MatMul only

variants.name: int8-full
variants.change: Same fixed quantization plus Gather embedding weights

data: Reused validation207 and frozen head/map;1000 new independent risk queries and600 new locked queries from unused components excluding all prior campaign cohorts. No new model fitting. Old600-query test is retired and never relabeled.
screen: Validation raw accuracy drop<=.01, label agreement>=.98, definitive coverage loss<=.02. Keep80% floor, exact per-query risk bound with alpha=.05/3 and at least30 selected. Reject failed variants before locked use.
performance: Paired local verify_evidence path at one CPU thread, no result cache, same validation queries and repeated seeded order, after other CPU jobs finish. Require>=20% point reduction in P50 andP95 and>=30% model-file reduction; record uncertainty and peak process RSS. This is not network/agent/Gemini latency.
selection: Choose smallest qualified variant passing quality/performance gates before locked predictions; retain FP32 if no improvement. Do not select a winner from test results.
heldout: Paired noninferiority margins declared before scoring: epsilon=.01 raw accuracy, delta=.02 definitive coverage, with selective-risk upper<=.20. Report paired intervals; do not claim equivalence outside those tolerances.
limits: Local CPU only; two fixed quantization configurations, no new cloud spending, public weights or production deployment. Preserve both failed and successful artifacts.
